Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
bad...@iafrica.com writes:
>Here's one for all you rulemongers, sorry if it's an old one.
>Victoria's special ability says:_If Victoria is ready during your master
>phase,
>you may forfeit the edge to gain 2 pool_.
>What I would like to know is; if you use this ability must you tap Victoria
>and/or will doing this use up your master phase action?

> All help will be appreciated. Thank-you

The ability is independent of the master phase action and of Victoria's
tapping. So, "no" to both. The only cost you incur when using her
special ability is the loss of the Edge.

> REF wrote:

> > bad...@iafrica.com wrote:
> >
> > >Here's one for all you rulemongers, sorry if it's an old one.
> > >Victoria's special ability says:_If Victoria is ready during your
> > >master phase, you may forfeit the edge to gain 2 pool_.
>
> <stuff killed because it is allready answered>
>
> > Please note that you can give up the edge and regain it later with
> > Madness Network at the end of your predators turn to keep getting 3
> > blood a turn from that edge.
> > Rory
>
> Because you give up the edge during your master phase, you can simply
> bleed during your minion phase (as usual) to regain the edge. You don't
> need the Madness Network to do so.

Note that it was stated "at the END of your _Predator's_ turn. This
allows you to have the Edge when your master phase comes around (just because
you get the Edge during your turn doesn't mean that you will keep it until
your next turn). Thus, Madness Network is required.

True, but getting it with the Network at the end of your predator's minion
phase makes it so that it's impossible for anyone to take it from you before
your turn. You can't say the same about getting it at any other time, really.
